name: Grimm's Honey & Garlic Pepperoni, 600g
description: Ready to eat meat snack. Grimm’s Honey Garlic Pepperoni Sticks are a high-protein choice with absolutely no fuss; a quick and easy way to get protein no matter how busy your schedule. A sweet and savoury snack, naturally smoked and bursting with flavour! Made with real honey. A great addition to any packed lunch and an easy choice for snacks, bursting with flavour. Made with our quality cuts of pork & beef. Great for all occasions, a quick snack, a great addition to kids’ lunches and after-school snacks, party trays and everything in between!
